contract: RE-SHARED-IMPL.md signatures plus the per-call geometry extensions in spacewarp_est.h
mv_units: RGBA16F, rg = native input-texel offset / native input size (uv displacement), ba = 0

mv_gen: downsample pyramid (working longest side <= 1024, half levels to 64)
dense coarse search (full +-96 native-pixel envelope, integer steps, no gaps)
dense +-2 level refinement seeded by the previous level
native +-2 refinement with corrected quadratic subpel -> final uv map
extrapolate: single-texture backward warp: dst(q) = src(q + mv*fovScale*(1 - scaleFactor)), clampMagnitude then sr.mode/sr.radius stretch then uv clamp
align: rotation-only homography R_A * R_B^T from the two view matrices and asymmetric FOV tangents

expected_outcomes.name: swp_dense_frag (QCOM as-is)
expected_outcomes.probe: SWP_SAD macro pointed at a plain-GLSL stub -> exit 0

shader_syntax.note: glslang rejects GL_QCOM_block_match; the probe validates the direct shader grammar. The shipped estimator does not arm QCOM: the prior parity probe compared two portable loops, so it proved nothing about hardware SAD. Portable GLSL is the only production path.

math_test.description: pure-python mirror of the production thresholds parsed from spacewarp_est.cpp; deterministic frames

expected_cases.name: zero_and_motion_candidates
expected_cases.expect: zero displacement evaluated; 1% production improvement required

expected_cases.name: dense_gap_coverage
expected_cases.expect: every integer offset in the coarse envelope is enumerated

expected_cases.name: subpel_and_edges
expected_cases.expect: corrected quadratic sign, clamps, edge-neighbour fallback

expected_cases.name: head_rotation
expected_cases.expect: R_A * R_B^T maps B camera rays into A

expected_cases.name: compression_noise
expected_cases.expect: motion still recovered inside normalized error

statuses.8: portable baseline armed (QCOM unarmed until a genuine hardware-SAD parity path exists)
statuses.32: estimator budget exceeded during the last call

documented_gaps: guided filter refinement - out of scope
temporal motion statistics + scene-change detection - out of scope; the production improvement rule is the guard
TFLite 'Smart' global-motion stage - out of scope
MV-direction convention is estimator-internal (forward flow prev->curr at prev positions)
QCOM hardware SAD is not shipped; the previous parity probe was not a hardware test
